# Pipeline Contract

This file is the single contract for the seven-agent brownfield development pipeline. Agent and
skill prose must defer to it when describing workload eligibility, status transitions, output
ownership, or release authority.

## Ownership

| Agent | Reads | Writes |
|---|---|---|
| `01_architect` | Source and Maven metadata | `01-architecture/` and the knowledge graph |
| `02_story-analyst` | JIRA story register and architecture outputs | `02-story-analysis/` |
| `03_developer` | Approved implementation plans | `03-development/` |
| `04_existing-app-test-agent` | Development reports and their evidence chain | `04-verify/` |
| `05_additional-test-execution` | Development reports and test material | `05-test-gate/` |
| `06_audit-and-pr` | All verification and gate outputs | `06-ship/` |

`00-jira-stories/jira-story-*.md` is read-only input. Consumers access it through
`00-jira-story-register`; no agent or skill edits it (including its `Status` field).

## Status Transitions

```text
JIRA story
  -> Proposed plan
  -> Approved plan (human only)
  -> Compiled | Compile Failed | Refused development report
  -> verification, QA, and build reports
  -> Cleared | Blocked verdict
  -> optional published PR (Cleared plus explicit user request only)
```

`Compiled` and `Compile Failed` are both captured changes and are eligible for static
verification, the QA gate, and the build gate. `Refused` is not eligible because no diff exists.

## Decision Policy

- `NOT_SATISFIED` (acceptance-check) and build `Failed` are hard gates and compute `Blocked`.
- The merge arbiter may only override a computed `Cleared` to `Blocked`; it can never clear a
  computed `Blocked` result.
- A `Cleared` verdict is the only release authorization in the pipeline.
- Creating or pushing a PR requires both a `Cleared` verdict and an explicit user request. The
  publisher must apply the rendered development diff and re-run the relevant validation in an
  isolated worktree before creating the branch and PR.

## Output Ownership

- `03-development/README.md` is regenerated by `03_developer` with one auto-generated marker.
- `04-verify/README.md` is regenerated by the verification renderers with one shared marker.
- `05-test-gate/README.md` is jointly regenerated by `05a` and `05b` with one shared marker.
- `06-ship/README.md` is generated only by `06b-scribe`.
